lines.text: Cloudflare already ran hundreds of millions of tests a day with a tool called Flamingo.
lines.title: Flamingo

lines.text: They taught Flamingo to check DNS. It updates a record, then asks for it from every data center.
lines.title: The DNS probe

lines.text: The answer must be fresh within 90 seconds from name servers, and 600 seconds from the public resolver.
